verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is headless mode: the Antigravity CLI can run non-interactively to script agent tasks and plug into CI pipelines. That could let a developer trigger agents from GitHub or GitLab CI with their own setup, but no native integration is shown. Remote Control drives desktop sessions from a web browser, not from these platforms. Missing for 10: native GitHub/GitLab triggers (e.g. issue or PR mentions), any Linear integration, any Slack integration, and hands-on corroboration of CI-triggered use.
